ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation covers the central and proximal regions. Discontinuous white mottling is localized at the distal lobes. The right lobe displays a larger, more dense cluster of white pixel blobs near the upper trailing edge compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; internal angle estimated at 35-40 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Distinctly jagged trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude variations. Notable sharp serrations and jagged peaks are distributed across the entire trailing perimeter of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smooth convex curve on the lateral margins, terminating in pointed tips with high-contrast edge definitions against the water background.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular clusters and textured protrusions visible on the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the left tip, and scattered along the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical and diagonal linear scratches are visible on the dark ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization clusters are visible on the peripheral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and droplets creating a halo of high-intensity pixels around the lower perimeter and splash zone of the fluke.
